title: Misnamed-extension content detection
finding: Detection-only proof for `pin-magika-detection`/ADR-068 that the pinned Magika detector (`magika==1.0.3`, CLI transport) labels by content, not name. All 19 Experiment 31 corpus PDFs (8 silent-empty: 6 IA GlyphLessFont, 2 ACL WinAnsi; 11 healthy distractors) copied to lying `.py`/`.md`/`.txt` names still detect `document/pdf`; all 11 gate-corpus text/code files copied to `.pdf` keep their content-true labels (`code/python`, `document/markdown`, `document/text`). True-name baselines all-match (exit 0); swap sets exit 1 by design (shift reported). No fallback, timeout, or detector error; no ingest ran. Elapsed per set 0.24–0.86 s. Evidence regenerated 2026-09-16 with repo-relative paths (path-hygiene fix from PR review); verdict and gates unchanged
